document.abstract: This paper describes new stereophonic recording channel equipment including a six-position mixer and portable three-channel recorder. For re-recording, the previously described triple-track recorder-reproducer is available. For review-room and theater reproduction, a theater-type dummy equipped for three-channel stereophonic reproduction is described.
